meaning:
ὑγιής, -ές, accusative, ὑγιῆ (Attic usually -ιᾶ),
[in LXX for חַי, etc. ;]
sound, whole, healthy: Mat.12:13 15:31, Jhn.5:[4], 6, 9, 11, 14, 15 7:23, Act.4:10; before ἀπό, Mrk.5:34; of words, opinions, etc. (as in cl.), metaphorically, λόγος, Tit.2:8.†
(AS)
